scope: Refutes only the proposed extension of the phase-weighted punctured two-bank receiver obtained by substituting total mixed Pluecker volume for the missing per-bank three-dimensional projection energy while retaining the same absolute kernel integral |Phi_J Phi_K|. It does not refute QFORM or cancellation-preserving TT* methods.
summary: A strict five-source target family has an orthonormal three-row leaf frame with pure-bank rank two and normalized mixed squared-volume masses exactly 1/2 and 1/2. For iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2] leaves, the old absolute two-bank kernel equals |psi(zeta/sqrt(2))|^2 (integral |psi|)^2 and is infinite because psi(s)=2sin(s/2)/s is not L1. Therefore mixed volume alone is not an absolute-TT* norm bound; cancellation or phase-aware original-coordinate descent is required.
